fact: The Central Bank of Sudan revoked Al-Asjad's licence after a technical and legal committee review, and said it had taken measures to protect customers' rights.

CBOS Circular 7/2026 sets binding minimum rules for USSD financial services: fee disclosure, no debit on failed transactions, free SMS confirmations, 24-hour support and complaint resolution within 48 hours.

The Sudan Times reports that RSF leader Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo ordered traders in RSF-controlled areas to charge one price whether customers pay cash or through apps such as Bankak, with violators facing accountability, where premiums for digital payment had reached about 40 percent.
The Central Bank of Sudan revoked the licence of Al-Asjad Digital and Smart Solutions after review against its published standards, and said it had taken measures to protect customers' rights.
